high_level_description: A Plant-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a cheerful green bean-shaped creature floating centrally with a short sword and round shield amid colorful curved decorations and leafy sprigs.

style_description.aesthetics: cheerful, whimsical, playful, centered character composition
style_description.lighting: soft diffuse frontal illumination with gentle lower-edge shading and a bright upper-right highlight
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished fantasy artwork with clean outlined forms, smooth cel shading, glossy highlights, and softly rendered decorative effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A pale sky-blue field patterned with tiny white dots, soft cloud-like patches, simple white starbursts, colorful curved decorations, and small green leafy sprigs entering around the edges.

elements.desc: Small anthropomorphic pale green bean-shaped creature floating centrally with narrow black eyes, a tiny smile, pink cheeks, thin limbs, mismatched feet, and a jagged blue collar, holding a faceted silver sword on the image-left side and a round reddish-brown shield on the image-right side.
